title: Clayface Rotten Tomatoes score? Above 60
rules: If Clayface has a Tomatometer score of above 60 on Oct 26, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
The "Fresh!" and "Certified Fresh!" subtitles are meant for illustrative purposes only. The Tomatometer score must be above the strike value to resolve as YES (for example, a score of 75 would resolve "Above 75" as No.) The market will be determined the Monday after wide release at 10:00 AM ET.

This market and these products have not been endorsed by Rotten Tomatoes. Any references to Rotten Tomatoes or any associated marks are descriptive only and do not indicate an endorsement of this product or any affiliation between Rotten Tomatoes and Kalshi.

blind.reasoning: Clayface opens Oct 23, 2026 and has no critic reviews yet. Its director (James Watkins) and writer (Mike Flanagan) have good critical records, and test-screening and first reactions have been positive. Against that, the studio is holding reviews until late, which often signals a weaker film, and gory body horror divides critics. Overall I think a score above 60 is somewhat more likely than not.
blind.falsifier: When the review embargo lifts, the first wave of critic reviews puts the Tomatometer in the 40s or 50s and it stays at 60 or below through Monday, Oct 26 at 10 AM ET.

final.reasoning: The 83.5% price suggests traders see strong early buzz, so I moved up from 62% to 70%. That still leaves a gap: there are no critic reviews yet, the review embargo is late, and early reactions usually overstate the eventual score.
